description: Defines the URL class within the Thunder::Core namespace, including URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and key-value handling functionalities.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Represents a URL with parsing, validation, and encoding functionalities, supporting various schemes and key-value parameters.

classes.name: URL::KeyValue
